zh.name: 说出口的话与真正含义
zh.summary: 用上下或左右两个画面，将字面表达与本人想表达的含义配对。
zh.useWhen: 真实含义须由说话人提供或明确作为创作；区别于原句润色句库。
zh.instructions: 表达原话、经确认的含义、关系和配图
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Said and Meant Opinion
en.summary: Create an Instagram opinion carousel using the said and meant opinion structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the said and meant opinion format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

goals: 说出口的话与真正含义
imageCues: 上下两幅相同或连续人物场景，顶部黑色小情境条30–36px
中缝附近一段白底黑字“说出口的话”与另一段彩色底“想表达的需要”，38–48px
可在第二页重复上一页后把旧文字划掉、突出新的理解
